starter_scaling.why: per-statement RU from @@tidb_last_query_info, 20 of each, local TiDB v8.5.8 vs Starter aws-us-west-2 (2026-10-25): INSERT 2.90 vs 6.73, autocommit UPDATE 3.28 vs 7.23, SELECT FOR UPDATE 1.70 vs 2.55, point get 0.52 vs 0.50; bench-data ru-spot-*.txt

method: Resonate server (MySQL plugin) on a local TiDB v8.5.8 (ghcr.io/ostrium-labs/tidb:v8.5.8-loams.1, keyspace mode) over one PD + one TiKV v8.5.8; RU = sum over statements_summary(+history) of EXEC_COUNT*(AVG_REQUEST_UNIT_READ+AVG_REQUEST_UNIT_WRITE) for schema resonate, before/after each workload; bytes = sum(DATA_LENGTH+INDEX_LENGTH) after ANALYZE, delta per workload divided by its workflows
